typeHelp.DEPOSIT: Money you set aside for poker. It adds to the bankroll.

conversion.period: Everything is converted to {{currency}}, each amount with the rate of its day.

rooms.activeHelp: An inactive room keeps its history but is not offered for new games.

tags.help: Tags are created when a game is given one. Renaming a tag to the name of another one merges them.
tags.name: Name
tags.noSemicolon: A tag cannot have a semicolon.

delete.confirm_other: Delete the tag {{tag}}? {{formatted}} games lose it; the games are kept.

base.title: Base currency
base.help: When what you look at is in a single currency, it is shown in it. When it mixes currencies, everything is converted to this one with the exchange rate of each day. Your games and movements keep their own currency.
base.label: Show mixed currencies in

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.help: Reference rates of the European Central Bank, downloaded from Frankfurter when the app starts and every afternoon. Days without a rate (weekends, holidays) use the last one before.
rates.disabled: This installation does not download exchange rates: type them by hand below.
rates.failed: The exchange rates could not be downloaded
rates.noneNeeded: Everything is in one currency: no exchange rate is needed.

manual.title: Rates typed by hand
manual.help: For currencies the ECB does not publish, or to correct a rate. A rate is what 1 EUR is worth in the currency, from its day until the next rate; it wins over the downloaded one of that day.
manual.deleteConfirm: Delete the rate {{rate}} of {{date}}? The downloaded one of that day, if any, applies again.

errors.rate: Enter a rate greater than zero

import.title: Import games from a CSV file
import.intro: Load games recorded somewhere else from a CSV file in the format of the application. Only games are imported, all of them as finished.
import.duplicates: Games are not compared with the ones already recorded: importing the same file twice records its games twice.

errors.title_one: {{formatted}} error: nothing is imported until the file is right
errors.title_other: {{formatted}} errors: nothing is imported until the file is right
errors.help: Fix the file and choose it again. Rows are numbered as in a spreadsheet: the header is row 1.

games.label: Export games
games.onlyFinished: Only finished games are exported, with the filters of the list. Games in play are left out.
games.done: {{file}} has the finished games of the list. Games in play are not in the file.

movements.label: Export movements
movements.note: Every movement of the list, with its filters.
movements.done: {{file}} has the movements of the list.

backup.title: Backup of everything
backup.intro: A backup is one file with everything this installation holds: rooms and their logos, variants, every game (those in play too), bankroll movements and game templates. Keep it somewhere safe, or restore it in another installation to move to another computer.
backup.docs: Backups and when to use each kind
backup.restoreIntro: Restoring a backup replaces everything this installation holds with the content of the file. Choosing a file only checks it: nothing changes until you confirm.
backup.emptyInstallation: This installation is empty: nothing will be deleted.

replace.title: Restoring deletes everything this installation holds
replace.text: What it holds now is deleted for good and replaced with the content of the file: {{contents}}. Download a backup first if you may need it again.

errors.title_one: {{formatted}} error: nothing is restored until the file is right
errors.title_other: {{formatted}} errors: nothing is restored until the file is right
errors.help: The file was changed after it was made, or it was not made by this application. Positions start at 0: games[12] is the thirteenth game of the file.

confirm.title: Restore backup
confirm.deleted: Everything this installation holds now will be deleted for good: {{contents}}.
confirm.understand: I understand that the data of this installation will be deleted
confirm.label: Restore

backup.done: This installation now holds what {{file}} holds: {{contents}}.

breakdown.more_other: And {{count}} more names: search to see them.
breakdown.tagNote: A game with several tags counts in each of them, so the tags add up to more than the total.

templates.intro: The games you play often. Each template is a button on the Games page that starts its game in a click: in play, with today's date. Its small arrow opens the form filled from it, to change something first.
